notes.title: Update Notes for July 7, 2024
notes.content:
- Version number now 0.1.2.1
- Initial implementation of Steam achievements

Show off your Minesweeper skill by unlocking all achievements!
[list]
[*] Real Minesweeper - Win 100 games in any difficulty.
[*] Real Expert - Win 10 games in Expert difficulty.
[*] Stay Awake - Win 10 games in Nightmare difficulty.
[*] Play Like a Pro - Win 10 games in Classic Expert difficulty.
[*] Beginner - Win a game in Beginner difficulty.
[*] Intermediate - Win a game in Intermediate difficulty.
[*] Expert - Win a game in Expert difficulty.
[*] Nightmare - Win a game in Nightmare difficulty.
[*] Under 30 - Win a game in Intermediate difficulty under 30 seconds.
[*] Under 50 - Win a game in Expert difficulty under 50 seconds.
[*] Under 70 - Win a game in Nightmare difficulty under 70 seconds.
[*] 40K - Score at least 40K in Intermediate difficulty.
[*] 100K - Score at least 100K in Expert difficulty.
[*] 200K - Score at least 200K in Nightmare difficulty.
[/list]

notes.title: "Minesweeper 99" EARLY ACCESS
notes.content:
"Minesweeper 99" released as EARLY ACCESS!  

- Besides 3 classic difficulties, 4 more new difficulties are supported in the game.
- Over time, the game will update with more game modes and improvements.
- Best time (fastest) and high score leader board: [url=https://www.babafish.com/minesweeper-99/scores/DisplayScores.php?mode=raw&latest=1&difficulty=all]All Records (latest submission first)[/url]
- Please post your high score and/or best time record here or via Twitter/X @TheBabafish
- Please let us know if you have any feedbacks or run into bugs.  

Thank you for your support and feedback!  

--
Dev
